notes: Read on 2026-09-11 for issue #276. https://ritual.co/order?lat=&lon= server-renders the nearby-merchant list into the page's __NEXT_DATA__ — up to 36 listings ranked by distance, within 5 km of the point — so one request does not cover the city. This is the union of a 1 km grid of 210 points over San Francisco (37.7045-37.8330 N, 122.5150-122.3570 W), de-duplicated by Ritual's merchant id. Coverage is checkable from the grid itself: 61 points came back full, and the furthest listing any full point returned sat at least 1,261 m away, further than the 707 m from any point in the city to the nearest grid node, so every listing within the grid was within reach of some point. Each merchant's own listing page carries what the list does not — postal code, the weekly opening hours, and its categories. Both were fetched twice, and the two reads agreed on every field of all 53 listings. Hours are Ritual's ordering hours rather than the shop's door hours, and the many :15 and :45 closing times are the app's last-order cutoffs. The list's `tags` are not taken: they disagree with the merchant record's own `categories` (the list tags Poke Life 'Poke, Healthy Eats' where its record says 'Healthy Eats', and tags one Joe & The Juice 'MarketingPromo'), so `cuisines` is the merchant record's `categories`. Ratings, promotions and pickup instructions describe the merchant rather than the building and are left out.

coverage.remaining: None; every San Francisco listing Ritual returns for the grid is here.
coverage.note: All 53 resolved — 8 of them by hand: a number EAS files on two streets, two condominium buildings placed on the building's parcel, two listings that give a building's name instead of a street address, and two on Embarcadero Center, a street the city's address registry does not hold. 52 published; 1 declined, a business already on its page from another directory. 12 pages were seeded for it; the other 37 already existed.
